reviews.comment: Overall, thermo has very difficult material to cover, and at times it can be quite complicated. Dr. Lipkin did a very good job at navigating the complexities of the material and I really enjoyed the class. The homework's and quizzes seemed really bad at first, but they helped teach the material pretty well.

Great professor overall, took thermo from him and although it was very challenging for me lipkin made it much better. Make sure u go to class for quizzes and it actually helps, but well liked and respected professor. My goat

Definitely need to read the textbook, start homework earlier than you think you need to and same for studying for exams. Exams mostly came from homework or quiz material. We didn't get much extra credit but there was a curve at the end. Lectures are good, he's accessible outside class. Nice guy, it's just a really tough class generally.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Do NOT take this class with Demonic Donald. Just take it with Arroyave instead. Donald is mean and hates undergrads in general
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The lab piece is pretty demanding, especially for the second lab. The class itself is just statistics in a trench coat. Lipkin does a great job of explaining, I recommend going to lecture because personally I don't find stats to be intuitive

Although this class was tough due to the time frame given for the 2 in class projects, Dr. Lipkin was a great professor overall. He makes lectures worth going to even if attendance wasn't required. However, the main negative is that the class grading is heavily dependent on the TA grading your assignments. Overall, he made the class very enjoyable.

Dr Lipkin was great, and while we didn't have to be in class I enjoyed going because of him. The TA makes or breaks this class. Ours was a bit slow to grade and was very tough. Not a hard class overall.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Lipkin is a good guy, but the TA is ruthless. The grading so far has been harsh, have not taken the final yet.

Issues with the course are not with Dr. Lipkin, but with the TA and how the course was structured. The TA did grade quite hard and it felt he was being extra picky for no reason. The other review that mentions the final is impossible should be ignored, as the final has not been taken yet, and Dr. Lipkin did not teach MSEN 400 last semester.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The exams were hard, but everything that was on the exams had been previously covered in lecture. Plenty of extra credit is offered; for my semester, it was up to 20 overall points to my final grade. Extra credit was stated beforehand that it would be hard. Homework was challenging but graded fairly.

Dr. Lipkin was a great professor in MSEN 380. There were quite a bit of in-class assignments, but they were very simple. The class itself is not difficult and does not require much preparation, but it is a writing-heavy class which can be time consuming for some. This is not the fault of the professor, just how the course must be structured.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr.Lipkin does care about whether the students do well or not. His lectures are detailed and the slides have all the information that will be present on the exam. He is readily available at the end of class, email, or office hours. His homework is hard, but he encourages students to work together. Exams are hard but he gives a lot of extra credit.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This class is a preparation for capstone, so two main projects make up most of the grade. He grades really hard, and so does the TA, like unnecessarily hard. He gives us a go by report, but grades are completely different. In-class activities every day, and random time-consuming homework. Final is impossible.
Everyone bombed the tests so he would give out hard extra credit to make up for it. HWs are hard and grades are pretty bad. his eltures are very boring and have in class quizzes often. Bad guy
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Lipkin is the GOAT of MSEN classes at TAMU. He made thermo easy to understand. He offered a ton of extra credit opportunities which bumped everybody a lot. He does have "pop" quizzes, but he uploads them to Canvas the night before so you get some prep. He basically lives in his office, so meeting him outside class isn't an issue.

Dr. Lipkin teaches thermo very well. The coursework itself is challenging and hard to grasp, but there are plenty of opportunities to raise grades through extra credit. He was more than happy to spend time explaining concepts that weren't clear and made the effort to make sure we understood the coursework.

25% quizzes which are 10 minutes long over a small portion of information. 25% HW which is not only difficult, but graded pretty tough as well (although that was mostly likely due to the TA). 50% exams which were surprisingly the easiest part of the grade. He gives extra credit HW for exam points which honestly saved the grades. Best of luck frens.
